title: Story premise EDU007: The Purple-Paint Conveyor
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Will two extra scoops keep this purple the same? Takeaway/theme: Scaling a ratio multiplies every part by the same factor.
description: A mural robot must preserve a two-to-three blue-red mixing recipe while making a larger batch, but adding the same number to both ingredients changes the recipe. Doubling both counts restores the intended ratio.
